name: Unna (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Unna (a red castle with pennants on white).
history: Municipal flag of Unna; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Unna arms — red castle with pennants on white
